skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts, theories, and tools in occupational health and safety management to mitigate workplace accidents and occupational diseases.
Analyze and evaluate risks in occupational health and safety management using qualitative and quantitative methods.
Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to assess factors influencing occupational health and safety management.
Evaluate policies and practices related to occupational health and safety management in organizations.
Communicate effectively about occupational health and safety issues to stakeholders.
Collaborate effectively in teams to analyze and solve occupational health and safety issues.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address workplace accidents and occupational diseases.
Critically analyze and evaluate occupational health and safety issues and propose solutions.
Demonstrate leadership in occupational health and safety management initiatives.
Understand and implement strategies to prevent workplace violence and bullying.
Comprehend and apply relevant health and safety regulations in the workplace.
Implement measures to prevent occupational diseases and hazards.
Promote a positive workplace culture focused on health and safety.
